title: Continental Rummy
noSets: **Sets are never melds.** All fifteen cards must form sequences of one suit.
discardNotice: Not a go-out yet - tap a card to throw one.
washout: The stock is spent and nobody went out - the round is washed out.
tutorial.layouts: Only these three shapes win - **three fives totals fifteen and is still not a go-out**
tutorial.hand: Split all fifteen into sequences of one suit. Cards of the same rank count for nothing
tutorial.draw: Draw from the stock or the discard, then throw one card if you cannot go out
frontendHint.continentalrummy_draw_stock: the top discard does not finish it - draw from the stock
frontendHint.continentalrummy_take_disca: the top discard completes your hand
frontendHint.continentalrummy_go_out: you can go out - press Go out
frontendHint.continentalrummy_discard_lo: throw a card that no sequence is using
frontendHint.continentalrummy_go_out_on_: the dealt fifteen already go out - worth 10 if you lay them without drawing
